title: Remove rear bumper cover, undertrays, exhaust and rear wheels

notices.text: Rear bumper cover comes off after the tail light surround fasteners and the wheel-well liner screws; it is held by long horizontal guide rails — pull it straight back, not down. Photograph the position of the bumper shims. Expect several broken plastic clips; buy a clip assortment in advance. Soak every exhaust fastener in penetrant the night before — 20-year-old muffler-to-cat nuts snap as a matter of routine.

steps.text: Remove rear bumper cover, undertrays, exhaust and rear wheels.
